stories.title: PDIP Tegaskan Bupati Bolaang Mongondow Utara Bukan Kader Banteng

en.title: PDIP Asserts North Bolaang Mongondow Regent Is Not Party Cadre
en.summary: The head of PDIP's executive board stated that Sirajudin Lasena, regent of North Bolaang Mongondow in North Sulawesi, is not a member of the party.

stories.title: Fajar/Fikri sumbang poin pertama beregu putra Indonesia

en.title: Fajar/Fikri Contributes Indonesia's First Point in Men's Team Event
en.summary: The men's doubles pair Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Shohibul Fikri earned a victory point for Indonesia's men's badminton team.

stories.title: KPK umumkan Bupati Bolaang Mongondow Utara sebagai tersangka tunggal

en.title: Anti-Corruption Commission Announces North Bolaang Mongondow Regent as Sole Suspect
en.summary: The Corruption Eradication Commission identified Sirajudin Lasena, regent of North Bolaang Mongondow, as a suspect in an investigation.

stories.title: DPR Sahkan 15 RUU Kabupaten/Kota di Kalimantan Jadi UU

en.title: Parliament Ratifies 15 Bills on Kalimantan Regencies and Cities Into Law
en.summary: The parliament approved 15 bills concerning regencies and cities in Kalimantan as law, which the interior minister said provides legal certainty.

stories.title: PDIP: Bupati Boltara Sirajudin Lasena yang di-OTT KPK Bukan Kader

en.title: PDIP: Bupati Boltara Sirajudin Lasena arrested by KPK is not a party member
en.summary: The PDIP party stated that Bupati Boltara Sirajudin Lasena, who was arrested by the KPK, is not a party cadre. The party only supported him as a candidate in the 2024 regional election.

stories.title: Polisi ambil sampel DNA keluarga 3 korban kapal Virgo di Solo

en.title: Police collect DNA samples from families of 3 Virgo ship victims in Solo
en.summary: Police are collecting DNA samples from families of three passengers from the Virgo Transport 8 ship from Solo for identification purposes.

stories.title: Banjir Bandang Solok: 2 Orang Hilang, 4 Luka-luka

en.title: Solok Flash Flood: 2 Missing, 4 Injured
en.summary: A flash flood in Gunung Talang District, Solok Regency, West Sumatra on Monday evening left two people missing and four others injured.

stories.title: Presiden Iran Mau 'Beri Pelajaran' Musuh di Pidato Majelis Umum PBB

en.title: Iran's President Wants to 'Teach a Lesson' to Enemies in UN General Assembly Speech
en.summary: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian plans to deliver criticism toward the United States and Israel during his speech at the UN General Assembly in New York this week.

stories.title: BMKG sebut hujan ekstrem 94 Mm jadi pemicu utama banjir bandang Solok

en.title: BMKG says extreme rainfall of 94 mm triggered major flood in Solok
en.summary: Indonesia's meteorological agency confirmed that extreme rainfall of 94 mm was the primary cause of a flash flood that struck Solok Regency.

stories.title: Terjaring OTT, Bupati Bolaang Mongondow Utara Ditahan KPK

en.title: Caught in sting operation, Bolaang Mongondow Utara Regent detained by KPK
en.summary: The KPK detained Regent Sirajudin Lasena for 20 days following a sting operation on suspicion of corruption related to extortion in local government.

stories.title: BMKG Ungkap Musim Hujan 2026/2027 Pendek, tapi Curah Hujan Lebih Besar

en.title: BMKG reveals 2026/2027 rainy season will be short, but with higher rainfall
en.summary: Indonesia's meteorological agency predicts the 2026/2027 rainy season will run from December to February with above-normal rainfall, prompting warnings for several regions.

stories.title: Sah, UU 15 Kabupaten/Kota Kalimantan Perkuat Kepastian Hukum Pemda

en.title: Ratified, Law on 15 Districts/Cities in Kalimantan strengthens local government legal certainty
en.summary: A regulatory update for 15 districts and cities in Kalimantan was ratified to align regional formation laws with the constitution and current territorial arrangements.

stories.title: Pengusaha RI Tersandung Kasus Uang Palsu Rp4,3 M di Kasino Singapura

en.title: Indonesian Businessman Caught in Counterfeit Money Case of Rp4.3 Billion at Singapore Casino
en.summary: An Indonesian entrepreneur was questioned in Singapore for allegedly using S$340,000 in counterfeit currency at a casino. The businessman claims he was a victim of fraud.

stories.title: Pipa Minyak Saudi Lumpuh, 4 Negara Asia Ini Terancam Krisis Pasokan

en.title: Saudi Oil Pipeline Shutdown Threatens Supply Crisis for Four Asian Nations
en.summary: The closure of Saudi Arabia's East-West crude oil pipeline may restrict oil supplies to several Asian countries.

stories.title: Ketemu Presiden Ini Harus Bayar Rp1,8 M, Kok Bisa?

en.title: Meeting Polish President Costs Rp1.8 Billion, How Is This Possible?
en.summary: Polish President Karol Nawrocki faced controversy after reports emerged of a package offering meetings with him for up to US$100,000.

stories.title: BGN Pecat Pegawai SPPG yang Diduga Ejek Korban Keracunan MBG

en.title: National Nutrition Agency Fires Employee Accused of Mocking Free Nutritious Meal Program Poisoning Victims
en.summary: Indonesia's National Nutrition Agency terminated an employee in Bantul who allegedly mocked victims of the free nutritious meal program poisoning. A government official also emphasized the importance of professional ethics.

stories.title: KPK Tetapkan Bupati Bolmut Sirajudin Lasena Tersangka Pemerasan

en.title: KPK Names Bolmut Regent Sirajudin Lasena as Suspect in Extortion Case
en.summary: Indonesia's anti-corruption agency designated Bolmut Regent Sirajudin Lasena as a suspect in a corruption extortion case. His detention is related to a road infrastructure project.
